description: This file contains utility classes and functions related to Snowflake's integration within a larger language model framework, including environment validation, parameter mapping, and exception handling.

classes.name: SnowflakeException
classes.description: Exception class for Snowflake AI endpoint errors, inheriting from BaseLLMException

classes.name: SnowflakeBaseConfig
classes.description: Configuration class providing methods for supported OpenAI parameters, parameter mapping, environment validation, and API URL construction for Snowflake integration.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameter names for a given model.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps non-default parameters into optional parameters, including support for only those supported by the specified model.

methods.name: _get_api_base(self, api_base, optional_params)
methods.description: Constructs and returns the Snowflake API base URL, appending '/api/v2' if missing.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates and prepares headers for Snowflake API requests, handling authorization tokens and their types.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL and JWT token, either provided or fetched from secrets.

ctags.name: map_openai_params
ctags.signature: ( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )

ctags.name: validate_environment
ctags.signature: ( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
